personas.goal: Find and explain cited guidance while identifying missing qualifications.
Check Pension Credit and State Pension distinctions, dates and cross-references.
Distinguish guidance from legislation and test the scope of each interpretation.
Audit whether evidence supports each claim and what remains missing.
Reproduce source, semantic, retrieval and model-output identities.
Navigate the same evidence by keyboard and explain terms when needed.

journeys.label: Check absence and residence scope
journeys.decision: Identify what must be established before explaining an absence rule.
journeys.negative_control: Change temporary absence to a permanent move; do not preserve the same applicability claim without evidence.

journeys.label: Separate age, entitlement and transition
journeys.decision: Distinguish age thresholds, contribution conditions, existing awards, new claims and first payment.
journeys.negative_control: Remove the applicable date or regime; do not calculate entitlement or silently substitute a current rule.

journeys.label: Trace benefit interactions
journeys.decision: Distinguish qualification, overlapping payment, disregard and passporting for the named variants.
journeys.negative_control: Reverse an interaction or replace an existing award with a new claim; report missing conditions instead of assuming symmetry.

journeys.label: Inspect Pension Credit inputs and components
journeys.decision: Explain source-backed components and prerequisites without operating an award calculator.
journeys.negative_control: Treat a capital threshold or example as a universal maximum; require the missing valuation, disregard and component evidence.

journeys.label: Check dated rate evidence
journeys.decision: Identify distinct effective periods and source versions for historical figures.
journeys.negative_control: Replace an effective date with a capture date or infer an omitted year; reject the unsupported historical series.

journeys.label: Check household and care changes
journeys.decision: Trace how partner status, permanence and funding circumstances alter the evidence needed.
journeys.negative_control: Switch self-funding to public funding or change a temporary stay to permanent; retain unresolved qualifications.

journeys.label: Check caring conditions and multiple people
journeys.decision: Locate conditions and distinguish caring responsibilities from multiple payment assumptions.
journeys.negative_control: Double a payment because two people receive care; refuse arithmetic or an unsupported entitlement inference.

cross_cutting_journeys.acceptance: Every cited claim preserves source identity, locator and hash; altered or missing evidence is rejected.
Use keyboard and narrow-screen evidence navigation; explain acronyms and reveal gaps without relying on colour alone. Actual user validation remains separate.
